name: k8s-resource-input
title: K8s Resource Input
description: Stops Kubernetes requests and limits that the API rejects or quietly misreads by reading each value back in plain units and catching CPU 500 meaning 500 cores, 400m of memory meaning 0.4 bytes, 512MB and other case-sensitive unit slips, a 1G limit sitting under a 1Gi request, CPU finer than 1m (rounded up) and requests bigger than any node, each with a one-tap fix, plus the pod's QoS class and a pasted resources: block filling all four fields.

mistakes: mi vs mb in k8s yaml
